sub: IP3 works across eight interconnected sectors where economic, institutional, environmental and technological risks overlap. We combine specialist sector knowledge with cross-cutting capabilities in economics, finance, governance, data and implementation.
tagline: Eight sectors. One integrated delivery model.

cards.title: Climate, Energy & Resilience
cards.description: Climate commitments must become investment-ready adaptation and resilient infrastructure.

cards.title: Education, Skills & Human Capital
cards.description: Learning systems must produce skills for changing economies.

cards.title: Health Systems & Social Protection
cards.description: Coverage and protection must be fiscally sustainable and well targeted.

cards.title: Digital Government, Data & DPI
cards.description: Digital transformation must improve services without creating governance or exclusion risks.

cards.title: Governance, Institutions & Public Finance
cards.description: Policies fail when institutions cannot implement them consistently.

cards.title: Economic Transformation, Trade & Private-Sector Development
cards.description: Growth must create jobs through productive investment and diversification.

cards.title: Sustainable Finance, ESG & Circular Economy
cards.description: Sustainability commitments must become investable pipelines and credible disclosure.

cards.title: AI & Emerging Technology for Public Systems
cards.description: Public AI needs readiness, governance and accountability, not software hype.

cards.title: Cross-Cutting Capabilities
cards.description: Economics, finance, governance, data and implementation expertise that cuts across all sectors.
